entries.name: AuthRegistry
entries.description: Registry of account authorization keys for the PrivacyBoost pool. Accounts register BabyJubJub approval public keys into Merkle trees with EIP-712 owner signatures (submitted directly or through allowed relays), and can rotate or revoke them. PrivacyBoost snapshots the tree roots and epoch proofs validate spend authorization against them.

allowedRelays.description: Relays allowed to submit account key registrations, rotations and revocations signed by account owners.

authTreeDepth.description: Depth of the auth Merkle trees.

entries.name: Groth16EpochVerifier
entries.description: Groth16 verifier for PrivacyBoost private transfer / withdrawal epoch proofs. Verification keys are stored in SSTORE2 data contracts, keyed by circuit configuration (max transfers, inputs and outputs per transfer). Registered epoch keys are not enumerable on-chain.

entries.name: TokenRegistry
entries.description: Registry mapping compact token IDs to the ERC-20 tokens accepted by the PrivacyBoost pool.

nextId.description: Latest token ID assigned; tokens are registered with IDs 1..nextId.

tokens.description: Registered tokens (token type, token address, sub-id) by token ID.

entries.name: AuditGateway
entries.description: Manages the list of auditors authorized to query private user data through the Audit API of the TEE, and stores an onchain log of every audit access so that users can publicly verify whether and when their private data was disclosed.

auditLogger.description: Address (TEE server wallet) that records every Audit API access on-chain by calling the AuditGateway.

getAllAuditors.description: Auditors authorized to fetch the balance and transaction history of any address through the Audit API of the TEE. Every such access is logged onchain.

auditLogCount.description: Total number of audit accesses logged onchain.

entries.name: Groth16DepositVerifier
entries.description: Groth16 verifier for PrivacyBoost deposit epoch proofs. Verification keys are stored in SSTORE2 data contracts, registered per supported batch size.

supportedParams.description: Deposit batch sizes with a registered verification key.

vkInfo.description: Verification key pointers (IC length, SSTORE2 constants contract) per supported batch size.

entries.name: PrivacyBoost
entries.description: Main contract of the PrivacyBoost private transfer pool. It escrows registered ERC-20 tokens deposited against note commitments, and lets allowed relays batch private transfers and withdrawals into epochs that are verified with Groth16 proofs against a note Merkle tree. Users can exit without relay cooperation via a delayed forced withdrawal with their own proof.

allowedRelays.description: Relays allowed to submit epochs to the pool.

epochVerifier.description: Groth16 verifier used for private transfer / withdrawal epoch proofs.

depositVerifier.description: Groth16 verifier used for deposit epoch proofs.

forcedVerifier.description: Groth16 verifier used for forced withdrawal proofs.

tokenRegistry.description: Registry of ERC-20 tokens accepted by the pool.

authRegistry.description: Registry of account authorization keys whose tree roots are snapshotted and used to validate spend authorization in epoch proofs.

withdrawFeeBps.description: Withdrawal fee in basis points, charged on withdrawals and forced withdrawals.

cancelDelay.description: Number of blocks after which an unprocessed deposit request can be cancelled and refunded by the depositor.

forcedWithdrawalDelay.description: Number of blocks between requesting and executing a forced withdrawal.

authSnapshotInterval.description: Block interval between snapshots of auth tree roots.

entries.name: Groth16ForcedVerifier
entries.description: Groth16 verifier for PrivacyBoost forced withdrawal proofs, used by the permissionless exit path. Verification keys are stored in SSTORE2 data contracts, registered per supported input count.

supportedParams.description: Forced withdrawal input counts with a registered verification key.

vkInfo.description: Verification key pointers (IC length, SSTORE2 constants contract) per supported input count.
